pages: Welcome to the quest for the ultimate e-companion. Please set your Elektron Box to USB/MIDI (switch Overbridge off).
MIDI channels 9-16 control the instrument and FX slots by default. CC 70-77 control whatever you like. You can change this in the settings.
I have now added a few sampler engines due to popular demand.
I made some changes to the layouts so they look better on different phones. We have different skins now in the settings.
Please send me feedback with SEND LOG on the settings page. The quest needs it.
